cases.question: How do I reset my password?
cases.baseline_answer: Click “Forgot password” on the login page and enter your email. A reset link will be sent to you and is valid for 30 minutes. Let me know if you need any more help!
cases.candidate_answer: Click “Forgot password” on the login page, enter your email, and follow the link that’s sent to you. The reset link is valid for 30 minutes.

cases.question: What plans and pricing do you offer?
cases.baseline_answer:
We offer three plans:  
- Free: 5 GB of storage.  
- Pro: $9 / month for 100 GB.  
- Team: $20 / user / month for 1 TB shared storage.
cases.candidate_answer: We offer a Free plan with 5 GB, a Pro plan at $9 per month for 100 GB, and a Team plan at $20 per user per month for 1 TB of shared storage.

cases.question: Is there a free trial?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! Pro users can try it out with a 14‑day free trial—no credit card is required.
cases.candidate_answer: Yes. Pro has a 14‑day free trial and no credit card is required.

cases.question: How do I cancel my subscription?
cases.baseline_answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. You’ll keep access until the end of the current billing period.
cases.candidate_answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan. You’ll keep access until the end of the current billing period.

cases.question: What is your refund policy?
cases.baseline_answer: We give a full refund if you ask within 14 days of your first purchase. After 14 days, payments are not refunded. Let us know if you need help with a refund request!
cases.candidate_answer: We give a full refund if you request it within 14 days of your first purchase. After 14 days, payments are not refunded.

cases.question: What is the maximum file size I can upload?
cases.baseline_answer: Free accounts can upload files up to 250 MB, while Pro and Team accounts allow uploads up to 2 GB.
cases.candidate_answer: Free accounts can upload files up to 250 MB, while Pro and Team accounts allow uploads up to 2 GB.

cases.question: Can I recover a deleted file?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! Deleted files stay in the Trash for 30 days, and you can restore them from there.
cases.candidate_answer: Yes. Deleted files stay in the Trash for 30 days and can be restored from there.

cases.question: Is my data encrypted?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! All your files are encrypted with AES‑256 at rest and protected with TLS 1.3 while in transit.
cases.candidate_answer: Yes. Files are encrypted with AES‑256 at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit.

cases.question: How do I contact support?
cases.baseline_answer: You can reach us by emailing support@cloudnest.example or using the live chat Monday‑Friday, 9 am‑6 pm IST. We aim to reply to emails within 24 hours. Let us know how we can help!
cases.candidate_answer: You can reach us by emailing support@cloudnest.example or using the live chat Monday‑Friday, 9 am‑6 pm IST. We reply to emails within 24 hours.

cases.question: How do I delete my account?
cases.baseline_answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. The deletion will be permanent after a 14‑day grace period. Let us know if you need any more help!
cases.candidate_answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. The deletion becomes permanent after a 14‑day grace period.

cases.question: I forgot my password, how do I get back into my account?
cases.baseline_answer: Sure! Click “Forgot password” on the login page, enter your email, and you’ll receive a reset link that’s valid for 30 minutes. Use that link to set a new password. Let me know if you need any more help!
cases.candidate_answer: Click “Forgot password” on the login page, enter your email, and you’ll receive a reset link that’s valid for 30 minutes. Use that link to set a new password and log back in.

cases.question: What does the Pro plan cost per month?
cases.baseline_answer: The Pro plan costs $9 per month for 100 GB of storage.
cases.candidate_answer: The Pro plan costs $9 per month for 100 GB of storage.

cases.question: I bought Pro yesterday and don't like it. Can I get my money back?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! You’re eligible for a full refund if you request it within 14 days of your first purchase. Just let us know and we’ll process it promptly.
cases.candidate_answer: Yes, you can request a full refund within 14 days of your first purchase. Since you bought Pro yesterday, you’re still within that window.

cases.question: Is it possible to get my deleted photos back?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! Deleted photos stay in the Trash for 30 days. You can restore them from there anytime before they’re permanently removed.
cases.candidate_answer: Yes, you can recover deleted photos. They stay in the Trash for 30 days, so just open Trash and restore the files you need.

cases.question: Does CloudNest have a Linux app?
cases.baseline_answer:
Yes, CloudNest supports Web, Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS.  
There isn’t a Linux desktop app available right now.
cases.candidate_answer: We currently support Web, Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS. There isn’t a Linux desktop app available at the moment.

cases.question: Can I protect a shared link with a password?
cases.baseline_answer: Yes! When you share a file, click the Share button to create a link. Pro users can add a password (and an expiry date) to that link.
cases.candidate_answer: Yes, Pro users can add a password to a shared link. Just click the Share button on the file and enable the password option.

cases.question: How many people can be on a Team plan?
cases.baseline_answer: A Team plan can have up to 50 members. Just invite them from the Admin console. Let me know if you need help with the invitation process!
cases.candidate_answer: A Team plan can have up to 50 members. Invite them via the Admin console under “Invite members.”

cases.question: What hours is live chat support available?
cases.baseline_answer: Live chat is available Monday to Friday from 9 am to 6 pm IST. If you need help outside those hours, you can email us at support@cloudnest.example. We’ll get back to you within 24 hours.
cases.candidate_answer: Live chat support is available Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm IST.
